question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Voracious
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Voracious"** means having a very eager approach to an activity, especially eating. (अत्यधिक भूखा)

 
 
• **Example:** He has a** voracious** appetite, consuming twice as much as anyone else at the table.
 
 
 
• **"Greedy"** refers to having or showing an intense and selfish desire for something, especially wealth or food. (लालची)
 
 
• **Example:** The **greedy** child grabbed all the candies for himself.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of **Voracious** is **Greedy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quenched** (बुझाना): Satisfy (one’s thirst) by drinking.

 
 
• **Example:** He **quenched** his thirst with a glass of cold water.
 
 
 
• **Appreciate** (सराहना): Recognize the full worth of something.
 
 
• **Example:** I **appreciate **all the help you’ve given me.
 
 
 
• **Compensated** (मुआवजा देना): Give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury incurred.
 
 
• **Example:** The company **compensated** the workers for their overtime.
